func TestZZTmpBindMapSlice(t *testing.T) {
	// GET + query params
	e := New()
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/?a=1&a=2&b=3", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	c := e.NewContext(req, rec)
	dst := new(map[string][]string)
	err := new(DefaultBinder).Bind(dst, c)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, &map[string][]string{"a": {"1", "2"}, "b": {"3"}}, dst)

	// POST + form body
	e2 := New()
	body := "a=1&a=2&b=3"
	req2 := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/", strings.NewReader(body))
	req2.Header.Set(HeaderContentType, MIMEApplicationForm)
	req2.Header.Set(HeaderContentLength, "11")
	rec2 := httptest.NewRecorder()
	c2 := e2.NewContext(req2, rec2)
	dst2 := new(map[string][]string)
	err2 := new(DefaultBinder).Bind(dst2, c2)
	assert.NoError(t, err2)
	assert.Equal(t, &map[string][]string{"a": {"1", "2"}, "b": {"3"}}, dst2)

	// non-nil map destination
	dst3 := map[string][]string{}
	err3 := new(DefaultBinder).BindQueryParams(c, &dst3)
	assert.NoError(t, err3)
	assert.Equal(t, map[string][]string{"a": {"1", "2"}, "b": {"3"}}, dst3)

	// map[string]string and map[string]interface{} must keep working (first value)

	err4 := new(DefaultBinder).BindQueryParams(c, dst4)
	assert.NoError(t, err4)
	assert.Equal(t, &map[string]string{"a": "1", "b": "3"}, dst4)

	dst5 := new(map[string]interface{})
	err5 := new(DefaultBinder).BindQueryParams(c, dst5)
	assert.NoError(t, err5)
	assert.Equal(t, &map[string]interface{}{"a": "1", "b": "3"}, dst5)
}
